author: Abu_Maryam
quote: Easily the worst GTA in the series. Beyond the "6" in the title, it brings zero innovation, no new ideas, and no real gaming tech that moves the industry forward. Instead of the fearless, unapologetic crime we expect from GTA, the protagonist feels weak in criminal missions and weighed down by guilt and remorse—as if the game keeps reminding you that you're doing something wrong instead of letting a game just be a game. Worse, the marketing leaned on cheap shock value like nudity instead of real boldness. And running an unstable 30fps in 2026 is a joke—I'd gladly take normal graphics at a smooth 60fps over fancy visuals struggling to hold 30fps. A massive disappointment that wasted my time and money.

author: Abu_Maryam
quote: Once again, nothing new here. As always, it’s just noise, overpromises, and marketing talk without any real action. Every year they show up at events claiming they’ve added new features, but in reality, they just make things **** truth is, this series hasn’t felt fresh or innovative since Black Ops 2. That was the last time Call of Duty had real impact. After that, the franchise essentially died, and I honestly don’t know how it’s still alive—probably just feeding on the weak-minded players who keep buying it every year and getting fooled over and over again.Even the Zombies mode feels soulless now. There’s no real passion, no creativity, just recycled maps with pointless, silly ideas thrown in. Instead of building something meaningful, they’ve turned it into a shallow, frustrating experience.This game is bad—really bad. Easily one of the weakest entries in the franchise. I strongly recommend you do not buy it and don’t make the same mistake that so many people repeat every yearBO7 still empty, no innovation since BO2; terrible game, got it free btw
